body: Price ~₹50–190 adjusted 2008–2016 (fell 74% in 2008, ₹191→₹49.6; sideways ₹76–186 for 8 years). Move began 2016–17: premiumisation (Magic Moments, later Rampur/Jaisalmer), D/E 0.77→0.15 (FY17–21), revenue +44% vs PAT +239% (₹80→271 cr) = operating leverage. FY26 PAT ~₹602 cr; premium >50% of revenue. ~38x ≈ PAT ×7.5 × P/E ×5 (18x→90x). User's '2008 UBL issue' story is wrong: UBL = United Breweries (beer). Real UB link: 1990s Mallya refused partnership → Radico built 8PM (1998). Nov 2026: ₹62k cr, 78x — priced.

title: Radico Khaitan multibagger (2016–2026)

body: ₹38.3 (Mar 2009) → ATH ₹10,238 (Aug 2022) ≈267x; standalone P/E 4.9 → 103 (21x) × implied EPS ~12.7x, so about 54% of the log-return was rerating. The last leg, ₹599 (Mar 2020) → ₹10,238 in 2.4 years (17x), had TTM EPS only ~2.5x and P/E 15 → 103. Drawdowns: −78% (2007–09), −53% (2016), −59% (2018–20). Then −70% to ₹3,093 (Oct 2026); ₹3,725 on 19 Nov 2026 (−64%), even though EPS is ~16% above the 2022 level (TTM ₹99.7 → ₹115.7). Early signal (2013–15): pivot to automotive/media design-and-technology services; OPM 18% → 26%, ROCE 40–60%, zero debt, still at P/E ~20 in 2014. Ended: FY26 revenue flat (₹3,729 cr → ₹3,757 cr), 9M FY26 revenue −2% YoY with EBITDA margin −534 bps, the transportation vertical (largest, JLR-heavy) weak on global auto spending cuts, and AI-disruption fears for ER&D services; brokers cut targets (MOSL Sell ₹3,100, Jul 2026). Lesson: a rerating-only leg (P/E ~7x in two years) reverses fully when growth stalls; a 100x P/E on ~25% growth did not allow for an auto downcycle or client concentration.

data.ended: revenue stall FY26, auto spend cuts, AI fears
